name: Raycast
summary: Extendable launcher for macOS and Windows with built-in productivity tools and optional AI.
description: Raycast is a keyboard launcher for macOS, with Windows and iOS versions, that bundles core tools such as window management and notes, plus thousands of extensions from its store. The Free plan includes core features without AI. Pro costs $8 per month billed annually and adds AI with 500 credits during the trial, and team plans start at $12 per user per month.

howToUse.title: Open Raycast
howToUse.description: Open Raycast and use the keyboard launcher on macOS, or the Windows and iOS versions.

howToUse.title: Use the bundled core tools
howToUse.description: Raycast bundles core tools such as window management and notes, and you reach them from the keyboard.

howToUse.title: Add extensions from the store
howToUse.description: Add extensions from the store. The page says there is an extension for many of the apps you already use, and the store holds thousands of them.

howToUse.title: Choose Free or Pro
howToUse.description: The Free plan includes the core set without AI. Pro costs $8 per month billed annually and adds AI with 500 credits during the trial. Team plans start at $12 per user per month.
